prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1230; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described in your file. Our client was involved in a low-speed head-on collision and has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office and not to our client.

We ask that you provide the full policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a certified declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm in writing whether any other policies, excess coverage, or umbrella coverage may apply.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle inspection reports, event data recorder downloads, telematics information, claim notes, adjuster communications, witness statements, and any recorded calls. Please ensure that no vehicle or component is repaired, salvaged, or disposed of without prior written notice to this office.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter within ten days.
